title: Story-start standing pressures
scope: Qualitative configuration of the standing, unresolved pressures shaping the settlement and its region at story start; every occurred event, named party, timeline, escalation, institution, species presence, and resolution remains open.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17, through the explicit multiple-choice review of the displayed options, the Author selected an amended custom option rather than A, B, or C: rivalry-forward salience with five standing pressure classes, describing the wildlife classes in author-facing shorthand as 'hags, goblins, mega-fauna, wolves, bears (our world equivalents)' — Earth-creature words that are shorthand only, never in-world taxonomy, and that establish no species identity, biology, or local presence.
question: Which qualitative configuration of standing, unresolved pressures shapes the settlement and its region at story start — which pressure classes exist, what public salience each carries, how they couple, and through which evidence classes the returning peoples are known locally — without establishing any plot event, occurred incident, named party, timeline, or resolution?
selection: Use the Author-amended custom option — RIVALRY-FORWARD. Five standing pressure classes are simultaneously live at story start and none is resolved: (1) the approaching first succession, its rules incompletely settled per WLD-CULTURE-002's designed succession ambiguity, which that record alone defines; (2) returning non-human peoples known at the settlement only through reported-only accounts, transient signs attested at a regional distance, and imported objects of uncertain provenance per WLD-ECOLOGY-005's provenance classes, with no direct presence or contact at or near the settlement; (3) seasonal ecological strain arising solely through accepted mechanisms — corridor disruption and crop exposure per WLD-ECOLOGY-004, pulse-mosaic variability per WLD-ECOLOGY-005, and lake seasonal variation within WLD-ECOLOGY-006's bounds — with the harvest-institution boundary intact; (4) cross-lake tensions and trade rivalry with the imperial-remnant industrial settlement (WLD-LOCATION-005), which audibly organises settlement politics and colours the succession question, with possible qualitative forms including contested exchange terms, intermittent embargo-like interruptions, and competitive claims of standing, no occurred incident, negotiation, or conflict event, and no future war, control-assertion, or escalation claim; and (5) returning dangerous wildlife as a felt pressure class — recovering megafauna per the accepted corridor and pulse records plus qualitative large-pack-predator, large-solitary-predator, uncanny solitary humanoid-reading predator, and pest-like-pack-raider classes, with the parked sapient pack species still parked. Returning-peoples reports and seasonal strain build in the background. Every claim is a standing state or tendency, never an occurred event.
alternatives: A — BRAIDED-THREE: all three displayed pressure classes (succession, returning-peoples reports, seasonal strain) simultaneously live with no dominant salience, contested ranking, bounded reported-only and imported-object evidence, and attentional coupling. Not selected.

B — SUCCESSION-FORWARD: the approaching first succession audibly organises settlement politics while returning-peoples reports and under-discussed seasonal strain build quietly, producing asymmetric preparedness. Not selected.

C — CONTACT-FORWARD: returning-peoples reports dominate with a flagged near-contact evidence class of transient regional signs, the succession question publicly deferred, and strain folded into general grumbling. Not selected.

D — RIVALRY-FORWARD (Author-amended custom option): five standing pressure classes including cross-lake trade rivalry with the imperial-remnant industrial settlement and returning dangerous wildlife as a felt class, with the rivalry audibly organising politics and colouring the succession question while returning-peoples reports and seasonal strain build in the background. Selected.
rationale: The amended configuration keeps every settled reality of the foundation capture live at story start while giving the setting the standing cross-lake rivalry that the plot intent staged outside canon requires as background. It schedules no event, resolves no pressure, develops no parked species, pre-decides no succession, and preserves the background build of the remaining pressures for later story use.
evidence: Author multiple-choice selection on 2026-08-17 of the amended custom rivalry-forward option.
consequences: At story start, five standing pressure classes are simultaneously live in the settlement and its region, and none is resolved.
The first succession is approaching and its rules remain incompletely settled per WLD-CULTURE-002's designed succession ambiguity, which that record alone defines and this decision does not narrow.

Returning non-human peoples are known at the settlement only through reported-only accounts, transient signs attested at a regional distance, and imported objects of uncertain provenance; no direct presence or contact at or near the settlement is established, and WLD-ECOLOGY-005's non-transfer rules govern all such evidence.

Seasonal ecological strain is a standing condition — stores lower than customary comfort and subsistence planning under visible adjustment — arising only through the accepted WLD-ECOLOGY-004/-005/-006 mechanisms, with WLD-ECOLOGY-006's harvest boundary intact.
Cross-lake tensions and trade rivalry with the WLD-LOCATION-005 settlement audibly organise settlement politics and colour the succession question.

The rivalry's qualitative forms may include contested exchange terms, intermittent embargo-like interruptions, and competitive claims of standing; each is a standing tension, and no occurred incident, negotiation, embargo event, or conflict event is established.
No future war, control-assertion, escalation, timeline, or inevitability claim is created; series plot intent stays staged outside setting canon.

Returning dangerous wildlife is a felt pressure class: recovering megafauna per the accepted corridor and pulse records plus the four qualitative predator and raider classes, with all species identity, taxonomy, biology, and local presence detail open and no specific creature established as present near the settlement.
The pest-like pack species remains parked and gains no biology, culture, language, ability, organisation, or presence development beyond WLD-HISTORY-001's recorded collapse-era spread.
Returning-peoples reports and seasonal strain build in the background under the rivalry-forward configuration.
Every claim is a standing state or tendency, never an occurred event, and the configuration is author-side truth known to characters only through available sources.
No watch, levy, patrol, stockpile standard, defensive measure, office, policy, or institution is established by any pressure.
No pressure has a System cause; System-facing interpretations are belief, no appraisal or report is omniscient, and no System event, mechanic, or CAL0 change is created.
No WLD-SOUL, WLD-PRENATAL, or other project default is adopted.
residual_unknowns: Which non-human people or peoples the circulating reports concern, their identities, numbers, locations, histories, aims, languages, and relations, and whether any reports are wrong, remain open.
The provenance, accuracy, and transmission chains of specific traveller accounts, transient signs, and imported objects, and any tale-lore built on them, remain open.
The strain's exact weather sequence, corridor and pulse composition, severity relative to other years, and regional extent remain open.
Store accounting practices, storage arrangements, rationing customs, and any allocation authority remain open; none exist yet.
The rivalry's particular forms by season and trade, and how exchange between the settlements physically moves — routes, carriers, and terms — remain open.
Which wildlife pressure classes later records develop into species, where, with what ecology, and whether any is present near the settlement, remain open.
How different cultures and professions interpret each pressure, including System-facing beliefs about any of them, remains open as belief-layer material.
Whether, when, and how any pressure escalates, resolves, couples further, or reaches the settlement remains open as series-contract and future-event territory.
All in-world names, dates, calendars, and units touching any pressure remain open.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted work cannot sustain five simultaneously live, unresolved pressures at story start.
Later accepted succession, rivalry, ecology, or history work contradicts a standing pressure rather than extending it.
Reopening of WLD-CULTURE-002, WLD-HISTORY-001, or WLD-LOCATION-005 removes a pressure's basis.
The series contract requires a different story-start salience configuration and the Author selects one.
The Author explicitly chooses another configuration.
